title: Choose the credibility landing page composition
question: Which structure should TMN use to make the cross-industry credibility offer clearest?

options.label: Credibility Chain
options.thesis: Offer and real cross-industry work share the first viewport.
options.viewport: A split hero pairs the promise with a four-project mosaic, then carries the visitor through one evidence chain.
options.risk: The mosaic needs careful mobile sequencing to keep the copy first.

options.label: Annotated Proof Wall
options.thesis: Real project surfaces become an inspectable record of TMN decisions.
options.viewport: The headline sits inside a wide proof wall with restrained annotations, then opens into a buyer-question ledger.
options.risk: Annotations can become visual noise if they are not tightly edited.

options.label: Referral Confirmation Path
options.thesis: The page mirrors what a referred prospect needs to confirm before contacting a business.
options.viewport: A clear offer leads into a connected confidence path, a cross-industry project filmstrip, and a deep proof ledger.
options.risk: The path must stay evidentiary and avoid reading like a generic process diagram.
